Container.Name: tailscale-mcp
Container.Overview: Tailscale MCP server, bridged over HTTP with supergateway (baked into the image) so any MCP client that speaks HTTP/SSE can use it. Lets an MCP client inspect and manage your tailnet - devices, ACLs, routes.
Container.Requires: A Tailscale API access token (admin console -> Settings -> Keys).

Config.Name: Host Port 8097
Config.Description: HTTP port supergateway serves the bridged MCP endpoint on.

Config.Name: tailscale-api-key
Config.Description: Read-only bind mount to a file containing your Tailscale API key (never put the key directly in a Variable).

Config.Name: TAILSCALE_TAILNET
Config.Description: Your tailnet name, e.g. your-org.ts.net or an email for a personal tailnet.
